tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every screen: the grouped grey in light, black in dark, as the web frame and Home paint it. The top bar sits on it at 88% with a blur.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, popovers and the chosen segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: the search field, segmented-control tracks, explanation-language pills, table header rows.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and surface-2 (15.1:1 on bg in light, 17.8:1 in dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, captions, counts, inactive tabs and segments. 4.7:1 on bg, 4.6:1 on surface-2 in light.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: card and chip outlines, table rules, the top bar's bottom edge.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, the chosen explanation language, the active tab underline, the mark's ground. White text on it reads 5.9:1 in light; in dark put bg-coloured text on it (7.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint behind a selected list row and the focus halo of the search field; accent text on it reads 5.1:1.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: The right form in a typical error. 4.6:1 on good-soft and 5.2:1 on surface in light; darkened from the website’s #1f8a4c to reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Highlight behind the corrected words of a typical error.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: The wrong form in a typical error and its ✕ mark; 5.4:1 on surface in light.

tokens.name: bad-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a wrong form when it is highlighted.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Notes that need attention, such as a draft translation. 4.7:1 on warn-soft and 5.3:1 on surface in light; darkened from the website’s #a86a00 to reach 4.5:1.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind a warning note.

tokens.name: level-a0-ink
tokens.usage: A0 Starter, blue on the blue-to-red scale: writes the level's code on its tint (5.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: level-a0-tint
tokens.usage: A0: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-a0-strong
tokens.usage: A0: fills its bar in the level mark, at blue's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-a1-ink
tokens.usage: A1 Beginner, cyan on the blue-to-red scale: writes the level's code on its tint (5.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: level-a1-tint
tokens.usage: A1: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-a1-strong
tokens.usage: A1: fills its bar in the level mark, at cyan's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-a2-ink
tokens.usage: A2 Elementary, green on the blue-to-red scale: writes the level's code on its tint (5.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: level-a2-tint
tokens.usage: A2: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-a2-strong
tokens.usage: A2: fills its bar in the level mark, at green's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-b1-ink

tokens.name: level-b1-tint
tokens.usage: B1: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-b1-strong
tokens.usage: B1: fills its bar in the level mark, at lime's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-b2-ink
tokens.usage: B2 Upper intermediate, yellow on the blue-to-red scale: writes the level's code on its tint (5.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: level-b2-tint
tokens.usage: B2: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-b2-strong
tokens.usage: B2: fills its bar in the level mark, at yellow's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-c1-ink
tokens.usage: C1 Advanced, orange on the blue-to-red scale: writes the level's code on its tint (5.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: level-c1-tint
tokens.usage: C1: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-c1-strong
tokens.usage: C1: fills its bar in the level mark, at orange's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-c2-ink
tokens.usage: C2 Proficiency, red on the blue-to-red scale: writes the level's code on its tint (6.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: level-c2-tint
tokens.usage: C2: ground of its badge in the level popover and the level menu.

tokens.name: level-c2-strong
tokens.usage: C2: fills its bar in the level mark, at red's own lightness so the colour reads clear in both themes.

tokens.name: level-mark-fill
tokens.usage: The level mark's capsule behind its seven bars.

tokens.name: level-mark-off
tokens.usage: A bar of the level mark whose level the part does not hold.

tokens.name: level-mark-text
tokens.usage: The level mark's range in words, A0–C2, beside its bars (5.2:1 on the light ground).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Inter, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.sans-uk: -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Inter, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: topic-title
styles.usage: A topic's title in its page head; 28px at phone width.

styles.name: home-title
styles.usage: The home page's title.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: h1 of track, cheatsheet and credits pages; 24px at phone width.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: h2 of a printed or on-screen cheatsheet. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: A topic's numbered section (h2) and a language card's name. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: An index card's section name and a cheatsheet's topic heading (h3). Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: h3 inside a topic section. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Regular verbs in -ar, -er and -ir drop the infinitive ending.
styles.usage: A topic's summary under its title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The ending names the person, so the subject pronoun usually drops.
styles.usage: Running text everywhere; the page default.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Table cells, tabs, the page's contents rail, breadcrumbs and search results. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Controls: the search field, the language menu, explanation-language pills, page tools. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips, segmented-control options, Up next summaries.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Counts and the pager's direction line. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Table column heads, upper case. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Group labels in sidebars, panels, cards and search results, upper case in muted. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: A level badge's code, in the level's ink on its tint.

styles.name: level-mini
styles.usage: The smallest level marks beside sidebar and contents entries. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: section-number
styles.usage: Section and card numbers: 00 for the cheatsheet, then 01, 02. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and identifiers. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard hints in the search field. Line height inherits the body’s 1.55.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a badge's halves' neighbours and tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs and segmented options; vertical padding of pills.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The most used gap: chips, pills, explanation-language lists.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of chips, pills and segments.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top bar gaps, panel padding, table cell side padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Top bar side padding and gaps between tabs.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card padding at the bottom edge; block spacing in a topic.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Page padding above the title on wide screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Small marks inside controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, segments, explanation-language pills, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The search field and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Popover panels (Level, Variety, language menu).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Language cards on the home page.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Index cards; the mark's corner (14 of 64).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Level badges: one pill, or two joined halves.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg in light; dark relies on the surface step and border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The chosen option of a segmented control, lifted off its surface-2 track.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Popover panels and menus.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The phone's bottom sheet.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The sticky top bar.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Chips and compact controls in the page head.

tokens.name: search-height
tokens.usage: The search field in the top bar.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Readable column of a topic page.

tokens.name: breakpoint-phone
tokens.usage: At and below this width the sidebar becomes a menu and the phone bottom bar appears.

tokens.name: breakpoint-wide
tokens.usage: From this width the contents rail sits beside the topic.
